description: "The Old Man of the Mountain, The Lovecharm, and Pietro of Abano" by Ludwig Tieck is a collection of tales written in the early 19th century. The narrative weaves together folklore and character-driven personal dramas, centering around the enigmatic figure of Herr Balthasar, a wealthy yet reclusive industrialist, and his complex relationships with those around him.
